title: E-Commerce Vitals Dashboard
short_description: A high-conversion shop built with Next.js and optimized for Core Web Vitals.
full_content: This project focused on rewriting a sluggish e-commerce platform using Next.js Static Site Generation (SSG) for product pages and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) for dynamic content, resulting in a dramatic reduction in bounce rate.

title: High-Speed SaaS Landing Page
short_description: Server-rendered landing page with full-stack capabilities via Server Actions.
full_content: A case study in using Next.js Server Actions to handle form submissions without a dedicated API layer, demonstrating a simplified architecture and reduced client-side bundle size for maximum load speed.
